description.zh:
需要查询DBLink的集群ID。

> 您可以通过[DescribeDBClusters](~~173433~~)接口查看PolarDB集群列表。
description.en:
The ID of the cluster for which you want to query the database links.

> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~173433~~) operation to query PolarDB clusters.
The name of the database link. If you leave this parameter empty, the system returns all the database links.

descriptions.zh: > 目前仅支持查询以PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）集群为源的DBLink信息。
descriptions.en: > You can query only the database links that use a PolarDB for Oracle cluster as the source.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb describe-db-links --db-cluster-id pc-a0000000000000 --db-link-name dblink_test --region cn-hangzhou
